candidates.headline: ISRO Completes Key Gaganyaan Crew Module Propulsion Test Ahead of Orbital Mission
candidates.summary: Indian Space Research Organisation engineers successfully validated the service module propulsion system under simulated mission durations. The milestone clears a major hardware qualification gate for India's upcoming human spaceflight program.

candidates.headline: Open-Weight Multimodal Models Reach Parity on Scientific Reasoning Benchmarks
candidates.summary: New open-weight frontier models demonstrated strong accuracy across university-level physics, chemistry, and coding evaluations. Researchers noted that smaller quantized versions can now run locally on university lab workstations.

candidates.headline: International Booker Prize Shortlist Spotlights Translated Regional Fiction
candidates.summary: Six works translated from five languages made this year's shortlist, highlighting independent presses and cross-cultural storytelling. Literary societies across universities have added the shortlisted translations to their reading circles.

candidates.headline: Technical Universities in Odisha Expand Semiconductor and Clean-Energy Research Labs
candidates.summary: Public engineering institutes across Odisha announced new interdisciplinary fabrication and power-systems laboratories for undergraduate and postgraduate students. The initiative connects campus projects directly with national R&D grants.

candidates.headline: Global Grid-Scale Battery Storage Capacity Doubles in Twelve Months
candidates.summary: Falling lithium-iron-phosphate cell costs and sodium-ion utility deployments pushed grid storage installations past record megawatt-hour targets. Renewable grids can now dispatch solar power reliably through evening peak demand.

candidates.headline: Linux Kernel Adopts Next-Generation Memory Safety Drivers in Mainline Release
candidates.summary: Core kernel maintainers merged additional Rust-based subsystem abstractions for storage and network drivers. The update reduces buffer-overflow vulnerabilities in high-throughput server workloads.

candidates.headline: CRISPR Epigenetic Editors Silence Disease Genes Without Cutting DNA Strands
candidates.summary: Molecular biologists demonstrated a durable epigenetic switch that turns off target genes via methylation without double-strand DNA breaks. The technique lowers off-target risk in therapeutic trials.

candidates.headline: Public Domain Archives Digitize 50,000 Rare South Asian Literary Manuscripts
candidates.summary: A coalition of university libraries opened free high-resolution access to palm-leaf manuscripts, early literary periodicals, and bilingual dictionaries. Students and historians can search the collection with OCR transcription.

candidates.headline: Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubits Demonstrate Error Suppression Below Threshold
candidates.summary: Physicists showed that scaling surface-code logical qubits reduced error rates exponentially as physical qubit counts increased. The experiment marks a shift from noisy quantum prototypes to fault-tolerant circuits.

candidates.headline: Open-Source Fellowships Open Applications for Undergraduate Student Contributors
candidates.summary: Major open-source foundations announced summer and winter mentorship cohorts covering systems programming, documentation, and technical writing. Selected students receive stipends and direct mentorship from project maintainers.
